start: AI Assistant open, a gym with members, some of whom owe money

steps.action: Type "Who owes money?" and press send (Enter on a computer)
user_sees: The question in a bubble
"Thinking…"
must_not: Two bubbles for one press
The box keeps the old words

user_sees: A card "Fees due: {n} members" with the rupee total in big figures
One row a member: name, "{amount} · owed for {days} days"
A link "Open Dues" (or "See all {n} in Dues")
A button "Send them a fee reminder"
"Free. Questions never use credits."
must_not: A total that differs from the Dues page
A member who paid in full
The credits number goes down
A member of another gym

user_sees: That member's profile; on a phone the assistant closes first
must_not: The wrong member opens
The chat is lost on coming back

start: AI Assistant open on the start view (no chat yet)

steps.action: Under "Try saying" tap a line in quote marks
user_sees: The words go into the box; nothing is asked yet
must_not: The question is sent before the owner can change it

steps.action: Tap "See all {n} things it can do"
user_sees: A sheet "What the AI Assistant can do": "Tap one to put it in the box. Change it, then ask."
Groups: "Messages to members", "Members and plans", "Money", "Questions about the gym", "Help with settings"
must_not: A diet plan example (not built)
A count {n} that differs from the lines listed

steps.action: Tap one, change a word, press send
user_sees: The sheet closes, the answer card comes
must_not: The unchanged example is asked

start: AI Assistant open on a phone or computer with a microphone

steps.action: Tap the microphone ("Speak a request"), say "Rahul ka plan kab khatam hoga", finish
user_sees: The heard words shown before anything is asked
must_not: The words are asked before the owner sees them
"Nothing was heard" shown as a crash

user_sees: The bubble marked as spoken
A one-member card for Rahul with the plan and its end day
must_not: The answer is about a different Rahul without asking which one
A credit is used

start: AI Assistant open; the gym uses batches

steps.action: Ask "How many members in each batch?"
user_sees: A card "Members with a running plan, by batch" with a big figure and one row a batch with its count
must_not: The big figure is the number of batches while the heading says members
Members with no batch counted in a batch

steps.action: Ask "This month's collection", then "Attendance this week", then "Show last week's summary"
user_sees: A money card, an attendance card, a week card, each with a link to its page
must_not: A figure that differs from Reports for the same days
Refunded money counted as income

steps.action: Leave the box empty or type only spaces
user_sees: The send button is off
must_not: An empty question is sent or counted

steps.action: Type words with no meaning and send
user_sees: "The AI Assistant did not understand. Say it another way."
must_not: A made-up answer
"Thinking…" for ever

steps.action: Paste a text longer than 600 letters
user_sees: The box stops at 600 letters
must_not: The text is cut later without the owner seeing it

steps.action: Turn the internet off and send a question
user_sees: A calm line that the internet is needed; the box works again
must_not: The question vanishes
The turn stays on "Thinking…"
It counts as a question of the day

start: A chat with two answered questions

user_sees: Both questions with their cards, newest lowest; the newest scrolls to the top on arrival
must_not: A card hidden under the ask box

user_sees: The start view again: "Today for you" and "Try saying"
must_not: Old cards come back
The button works while a question is being answered

user_sees: Only tasks show (drafts, sent, saved); plain questions are not listed
must_not: A question listed with a credit against it

start: The owner asks about a named member

steps.action: Ask "How much does Asha Verma owe?"
user_sees: A card for that member worked out from the gym's own records
must_not: The member list, phone numbers, dues or visits are sent to the AI
A name the owner did not say is sent

steps.action: Read the privacy notice on the AI Assistant
user_sees: What is typed or said goes to Claude; a member's name goes only if the owner says it
must_not: The notice says less than what is sent (the gym name, plan names and prices, batch names and trainers' first names also go)
